$comment: Maintainer-editable candidacy evidence for /thesis Section V. Same contract as thesis-disclosure.json: pending fields render the amber chip; filled fields render the value, the asOf date, and a Verify link. Values are observations scoped to their defined searches — negative results say 'no qualifying results found', never an exhaustive zero. The complete measurement definitions, sources, queries, UTC capture times, exclusions, and raw capture records live in thesis-candidacy-evidence.json (each row's Verify link); refreshing either file is a reviewed action.
